scope: Run03 current Mobile renderer capture review. Eleven 1280x720 PNGs were viewed directly. This is bounded desktop-render integrity evidence only; no phone, child, human-control-feel, or smooth-cadence acceptance is claimed.

runtime.setup: STATE_CONFIGURED: OperaAct.start(racer), then world._finale_start()/_show_phase(); subsequent touch and frame cadence were live.

telemetry.driver_note: Autonomous test driver generated 138 wall bumps; this is not human control-feel evidence.

painted_scene_finish.basis: The lagoon circuit remains highly polished, coherent storybook painting with strong value separation and a consistent pastel coral/aqua/purple palette.

actor_and_kart_finish.basis: The kart, Roshan racer, rival, and wheel are individually polished and recognizable, but their mounted scale and overlap become visually compressed in the race surface.

alpha_and_contour_integrity.basis: Viewed captures show clean cutout contours without obvious rectangular matte; no source clipping was observed in these states.

child_readability.basis: The bright karts read, but side-by-side cars overlap heavily and become small against the detailed backdrop, especially front_straight/far_bend.

composition_and_hierarchy.basis: The scene background dominates. The top-left back/lap controls are tightly clustered, the bottom steering panel is very large, and the race actors sit low or high against changing bend depth.

contact_and_depth.basis: Cars remain upright as intended, but bend states read as sprites sliding over the painted road: front_straight overlap and far_bend elevated placement weaken grounded contact and separation.

ui_art_consistency.basis: Controls share the storybook palette and outline language, but the oversized steering panel and circular top-left controls compete with the race actors and background.

cross_state_consistency.basis: The same approved actors persist across states, though perspective scale, overlap, and depth placement vary enough to make the pair feel inconsistently mounted.

animation.reason: Still captures and autonomous cadence do not prove smooth motion, timing, or child/device acceptance.

lowest_observed_dimension.status: Below 4.5; current evidence supports a layout/mounting repair priority, not immediate source regeneration.

source_assets.source_observation: Viewed directly; polished outlined coral vehicle with readable cockpit, wheel, and rainbow tail.
Viewed directly; clean shell-wheel icon with strong contrast.
Viewed directly; polished Roshan racer costume and contour. Runtime intentionally samples upper-body cockpit region.
Viewed directly; polished readable rival identity and costume.
Not used as a weakness claim from source pixels here; runtime zoom strips were visible as small road accents.

state_findings.observed: Scene and actors are legible; countdown circles are visible. Back control and lap dial sit close in the upper-left corner.
state_findings.risk: Top-left control cluster has little breathing room at phone scale.

state_findings.observed: Steering knob responds and karts remain recognizable; vehicles are concentrated at the right side with strong overlap.
state_findings.risk: The rival/player pairing is difficult to parse as two separate cars when side-by-side.

state_findings.observed: Both cars are near the lower middle and overlap heavily; the scene reads as layered cutouts over the track.
state_findings.risk: Weak contact/depth separation and low actor-to-background scale.

state_findings.observed: Cars are elevated near the gazebo and become smaller while remaining upright; the background remains visually dominant.
state_findings.risk: Perspective placement feels detached from the road and collision/ground shadow is not strong enough at this depth.

state_findings.observed: Finish flag/lap indicator and sparkles provide clear payoff; final frame is stable and visually coherent.
state_findings.risk: Finish still inherits the small/overlapping car composition; no separate winner emphasis is present.

weak_current_items.source_vs_runtime: Source kart and driver rasters are polished; weakness is runtime scale/depth/overlap in _draw_car, not proven source-art failure.
Procedural UI styling is coherent but tightly packed; requires current phone-scale review before changing dimensions.

weak_current_items.item: Oversized bottom steering panel versus actors
weak_current_items.source_vs_runtime: The panel is procedurally drawn in _draw_race_controls (surface source lines 414-467); this is layout competition, not a weak raster asset.

reuse_first_repair_process: First test layout-only changes: preserve all approved source rasters, adjust _draw_car scale/depth, separation, and grounded shadow; compare front_straight/far_bend/finish at 1280x720.
Retain side-view orientation unless a current design decision authorizes a new pose; do not regenerate kart or driver art for a mounting problem.
Re-capture ready, side-by-side steering, front straight, far bend, and finish on Mobile at 1280x720; include a controlled human/manual or clearly bounded driver trace for feel claims.
Only commission replacement art if a mounted comparison proves the source silhouette/contour itself fails after layout correction.
acceptance_gaps: No human-child control evaluation; 138 wall bumps are autonomous-driver behavior.
No smooth animation/cadence score from stills.
No separate close-up contact capture for vehicle wheel/road grounding.
The final state is complete but does not independently prove visual acceptance at 4.5 across all dimensions.
publication_note: Capture and run paths mapped to exact-byte public archive. Original raw run manifests preserve capture-machine paths. Source hashes retain their original before/after authority; these are bounded still reviews, not game-wide acceptance.
